name: River Development Agent Controlled Executor Invocation Foundation
architecture: GENERATION III CONTROLLED EXECUTOR INVOCATION FOUNDATION
invariants: DEV-273 consumes only the exact DEV-272 invocation-authorization result contract.
DEV-273 denies invocation when the predecessor is malformed, unauthorized, untrusted, unready, or inconsistent.
DEV-273 represents crossing the controlled invocation boundary as deterministic inert data.
DEV-273 does not call an executor implementation.
DEV-273 does not execute the authorized operation.
DEV-273 does not invoke repository inspection or any other execution dependency.
DEV-273 grants no repository mutation authority.
DEV-273 grants no shell, process, network, deployment, secret-access, scope-expansion, or external-side-effect authority.
DEV-273 preserves predecessor provenance, scope, receipt, operation, authorization, admission, eligibility, consumption, dispatch, and authorization evidence only after exact predecessor validation.
Rejected predecessor payloads release no trusted predecessor payload.
Actual operation execution requires a future explicit execution boundary.
